_comment: The optional 'conditions' block works on ANY trade type. Default logic is AND; set 'logic':'or' on the trade to require only one. Location conditions (biome, dimension, job_site_block, config_flag) are reliable; world-state conditions (weather, day_night, moon_phase, gamerule) are a snapshot taken when the offer is generated on villager level-up.

apprentice._comment: job_site_block wood_variant matches the horticulturist table's wood; here shown for illustration on any table-backed profession.
